final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ordersmark AS order_reference, AVG(remaincount) AS group_average FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(group_average) AS average_of_groups FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.order_reference, s1.group_average, s1.group_average - s2.average_of_groups AS step3_difference FROM step1 AS s1 CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2 WHERE s2.average_of_groups IS NOT NULL AND s1.group_average > s2.average_of_groups), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(group_average) AS average_of_groups FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.order_reference, s3.group_average, s3.step3_difference, s3.group_average - s4.average_of_groups AS step5_difference FROM step3 AS s3 CROSS JOIN step4 AS s4 WHERE s4.average_of_groups IS NOT NULL AND s3.group_average > s4.average_of_groups) SELECT AVG(group_average) AS average_group_average, AVG(step3_difference) AS average_step3_difference, AVG(step5_difference) AS average_step5_difference FROM step5
